extracted.intended_audience: NIH applicants and institutional eRA Commons users (PIs, Signing Officials, Administrative Officials, application editors) who use ASSIST to prepare and submit grant and administrative supplement applications
extracted.subtask_description: Procedures, system rules, and submission requirements for creating, editing, copying, searching, and submitting NIH grant and administrative supplement applications using the ASSIST web interface.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attachment file format and NIH formatting guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Some form fields allow or call for attachments, which must be in the form of a PDF. Applicants must review NIH eRA guidelines for formatting attachments before attaching documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Link provided: https://grants.nih.gov/grants/how-to-apply-application-guide/format-and-write/-format-attachments.htm. Enforce PDF format for all attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unique file names for attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: You must use unique file names for multiple attachments within the same form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Duplicate file names can exist across multiple forms but not within the same form; otherwise upload/conflict issues may occur.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage attachments (add/replace/delete/view) behaviors and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Process and UI differ for fields allowing a single attachment versus multiple attachments (Add/Replace/Delete/View behavior differs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add Attachment: click Add Attachment, browse to select PDF, click Submit. For single-attachment fields the Add button is replaced by Replace Attachment, Delete Attachment, and View Attachment and the file name displays in the field. For multiple-attachment fields files are shown in a table with Update and View buttons per file. Replace Attachment (single): Replace Attachment -> Browse -> Submit. Replace Attachment (multiple): click Update for specific file -> Browse -> Submit. Delete (single): Delete Attachment -> confirm in popup -> Continue. Delete (multiple): check Delete on Save for file -> Save and release Lock to remove. View Attachment: View Attachment (single) or View button (multiple) -> Open to view or Save to save locally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attachments not always copied; copying attachments is best-effort/optional and may fail
rubrics_metrics.description: When copying an application to a new opportunity, the copy feature performs a best-effort copy of form field data; attachments may not be retained and data loss is possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Copy Application UI includes an optional checkbox 'Would you like the attachments to be copied to the new application?' but documentation repeatedly warns that application attachments will not be retained and that data loss is possible due to form differences. Carefully check the new copy for completeness after copying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application project title: population and maximum length
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter a title for the application in the Application Project Title field; the title populates the Descriptive Title of Applicant's Project field on the SF424 RR Cover.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maximum number of characters for the Application Project Title is 200. After initiation you can update the project title by editing the Descriptive Title of Applicant's Project field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiation requires a valid Opportunity Number (NOFO)
rubrics_metrics.description: Prior to initiating an application, applicants must identify a Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) and enter the opportunity number (e.g., PA-12-987) to initiate an application in ASSIST.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NOFO text indicates whether ASSIST can be used. Entering the opportunity number on the Welcome page and clicking Go displays the Initiate Application page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who may initiate an application
rubrics_metrics.description: Anyone with an eRA Commons ID can initiate an application in ASSIST.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For administrative supplements both the PI (any PD/PI) and the Signing Official (SO) can initiate and use prepopulate features if organization IDs match the parent grant. An LRP application is accessible only to the Commons user who initiated it.

rubrics_metrics.name: SAM registration display and interaction
rubrics_metrics.description: ASSIST displays the SAM Registration Expiration Date for the lead applicant organization if it has expired or will expire within 14 days; users can click for SAM Registration Details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clicking 'Click for SAM Registration Details' opens a popup. If first-time registration, after OK a confirmation with Submit and Cancel displays: Submit forwards the application to Grants.gov; Cancel returns to the Initiate Application screen. The popup appears again at submission if SAM registration has expired.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiating administrative supplements: parent grant prepopulation rules
rubrics_metrics.description: When initiating an Administrative Supplement Application, you may optionally enter the parent grant federal ID so ASSIST can pre-populate specific data fields from the parent award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available prepopulation checkboxes: Project/Performance Site Location (pre-populate all sites from parent grant if marked; else only Primary Site) and Senior/Key Persons (pre-populate all Senior/Key persons if marked; else only the Contact PD/PI). Attachments such as specific aims, research strategy, and biosketches are not copied over because the opportunity or NOSI may request different information.

rubrics_metrics.name: NOSI format requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: If a Notice of Special Interest (NOSI) is entered when initiating an administrative supplement, the format must be valid.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Notice of Special Interest reference must be in the form NOT-XX-XX-XXX (example: NOT-CA-19-001).

rubrics_metrics.name: Behavior when initiating administrative supplements from eRA Commons
rubrics_metrics.description: If initiated from eRA Commons, the administrative supplement has the parent grant number pre-populated and that field cannot be changed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also note: while working in an administrative supplement initiated from eRA Commons, the Copy Application button is not available from the left side navigation buttons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Default post-submission viewing period and SO options
rubrics_metrics.description: By default, submitted applications have a two-day application viewing period during which the Signing Official (SO) can reject and revise an application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For non-competitive administrative supplements only, the SO can choose to skip the two-day viewing period and immediately release the application to Agency staff for processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delete application is permanent and restricted to Signing Official
rubrics_metrics.description: The Delete Application feature allows a Signing Official to permanently delete an entire application in any status; deletion is irreversible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The delete process provides two confirmation screens and the ability to cancel at each step. Once deleted the application cannot be accessed, re-instated, or viewed. You cannot delete an application if one or more forms are locked by yourself or another ASSIST user.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cannot delete when forms locked; specific error text
rubrics_metrics.description: An application cannot be deleted if any forms are locked by any user.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a form is locked, after continuing from the second confirmation screen you will see an error: 'The application cannot be deleted as the following form(s) are currently locked by <User ID> in: <application ID>: <locked form>'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for applications: parameters, case-insensitivity, and limits
rubrics_metrics.description: When searching for applications in ASSIST you may enter any combination of optional search criteria; parameters are case insensitive and punctuation is ignored.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entering no parameters returns all applications the user has privileges to access. If the number of records found exceeds the allowable limit, an error displays; in that case use parameters to narrow the search. Results can be sorted by selecting the arrow in column headings; Clear button resets fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Actions panel button availability depends on privileges and context
rubrics_metrics.description: The Actions section provides buttons for accessing features available for the application (or multi-project component) currently displayed; available buttons vary depending on privileges, workflow stage, application status, single- or multi-project, and which part of the application is being worked on.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples of potential Actions buttons: Add New Component, Add Optional Form, Change Component Order, Copy Application, Delete Application, Delete Component, Display Component Status, Manage Access, Preview Application, Submit Application, Validate Application, View Status History, etc. Not all buttons apply to every application or user.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copy Application: required validations and copy rules (single vs multi-project)
rubrics_metrics.description: When copying an application, ASSIST validates the entered opportunity number and checks whether the opportunity is single- or multi-project; a single-project cannot be copied to a multi-project opportunity and vice versa.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For multi-project applications the Overall component must be copied and the Copy To Component Type field for Overall is not editable. ASSIST shows components that can be copied and allows mapping to component types in the new opportunity. Error messages appear if validations fail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copy Application: what is and is not copied; privileges and statuses after copy
rubrics_metrics.description: The copy feature does a best-effort match of form fields to the new opportunity and copies structure/data where form field names match, but some fields and data are not copied.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fields that do not exist in the new form will not be copied. Submission date, certification, and Authorized Representative signature from submitted applications are never copied. Application and component history are not copied. When you copy an application you are granted Entire Application Editor privileges for the new application. The submission status of the new application and component statuses are set to Work in Progress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copying components: options and attachment checkbox
rubrics_metrics.description: When copying a multi-project application, ASSIST displays copy-from components with Project Title, Status, Project Lead, and offers a Copy to Component drop-down for mapping into the new application; default is Do Not Copy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You must copy the Overall component. You may optionally select a checkbox to attempt to copy attachments, but documentation warns attachments may not be retained and to carefully check completeness after copying.
